_about: ENG-02: toll rates per road for routes with real geometry (GraphHopper on the server), category 1 (car, height up to 2 m).
A toll run of the route whose road has no explicit segment in the world is priced as km x rate. Night tariffs are not known for these roads, so night = day.

weekend = Friday to Sunday (Автодор); public holidays are not modelled.
